name: Coupled Physics
description: A heat analysis and a stress analysis of the same geometry (both 2D or both 3D), solved together: the heat problem first, its temperature field handed to the stress problem (each analysis keeps its own mesh; every node of the stress mesh takes the temperature at its place in the heat mesh, nothing is extrapolated), then the stress problem with that temperature as a load of its own (thermal expansion coefficient and reference temperature come from the material). One Solve button, a combined result, the checks of the hand-over (nothing extrapolated, every point found, the average temperature kept, the stress solve used the field), a SELF-CHECK on stand-in analyses with known answers that prints PASS or FAIL beside the numbers, and a DIAGNOSTICS REPORT (also saved as diagnostics.txt in the project folder). It is a block of the Workbench: wire a 2D or 3D Thermal block and a 2D or 3D Static Structural block into its Physics cell. Not yet: pressure and heat-exchange transfers with fluid flow, structure moving the flow, a stress that changes the temperature, one window holding both setups.
